### TAG-137: Example 12.41 Four-value sequencer

**Status:** ✅ Implemented

## Software Notes

A simple pure association expression that continually rotates through four values. Each time it is invoked, it returns to the next value. The value is maintained in the invocation itself in the feedback association from the source list to the destination list. The value is initialized by setting the content of value<> to 0.

## Reference

```
// linear: TAG-137 Four-value sequencer
fourstate($value)(value< 0 >) $value

fourstate[(curvalue < >)($nextvalue)
  nextvalue <$curvalue( )> : 0[1] 1[2] 2[3] 3[0] ] 
```
